GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Settled Down 8th 5 Lengths off leader/winner in between runners held-up Straightening Up to 300m went through to be 5th x 200m 2nd x 25m, Sound Effort - # no run vital stage
Bit Slow Out 2 Lengths sat clear last 10+ Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, batled on ok but never a threat # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground (4L). A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Took hold Settled Down 7th Outside 5-6 Lengths Good Pace on, Clear All The Way Outside asked to go at the 400m 4th @ 200m Soon After Couldn'T Go On had its chance - run ended 200m - # poor recovery
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden with cover; settled off pace. Rdr reported his mnt was inclined to hang in through the early and middle stages, and it did not feel comfortable in its action when placed under pressure in the home straight and continued to hang in. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to have a poor recovery. Tnr undertook to report back on the post-race condition of the gelding, and advised it would now be spelled. Notwithstanding this advice, tnr was told a vet clearance is required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, ridden along turn, headed Straightening Up , battled on well # led/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure rounding the home turn. Rdr reported his mnt shifted in on jumping and consequently his right shoulder made contact with the gates leaving the barriers which caused discomfort and placed him at some disadvantage for the remainder of the race. He further added it had not been his intention to lead, however after the gelding began particularly well he allowed it to stride forward and obtain the lead without undue pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Restrained Settled Down 7th 3 Wide 5 Lengths off leader/winner Held Together Out On A Limb out Four Wide Turning for home 4th @ 200m, Kept Finding Closest on line, Sound Effort (b/off) # 3 wide, gave all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover from the 600m. Laid in under pressure from the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Restrained Settled Down 7th 10 Lengths Good Pace on, finally asked to go at the Turn , but you've left it too late brother , Kept Coming Closest on line (b/1st) # Sound eff/finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages when being restrained to obtain cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 8th Outside 6 Lengths following 1st x 2 Lengths to Straightening Up , clear run home Outside into 6th x 50m, # finished off ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in in the early part of the home straight and proved reluctant to shift to the outside. Rdr was reminded of his obligations to ensure that he rides his mounts out fully to the end of the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Inside 4 Lengths held together same to straightening up Ridden Along clear run home Inside got within 2 Lengths then # run ended 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the straight and approaching the 300m was directed inwards to obtain clear running.
